required_context: Conventional motor vehicle and identified stopping person.
Destination stop occurs on the roadway rather than as compelled safety braking.
Establish public-highway status, roadway and shoulder boundaries, and available passing space.
Identify the person bringing a covered vehicle to a stop.
One-way publicly dedicated highway open to vehicular travel; map roadway boundaries and available passing space.
Other vehicle travels behind ego; establish actual positions and movement.
Preserve normal and reasonable movement and the stop's causal effect as unresolved judgments.
Record all contemporaneous facts relevant to stopping necessity, compliance with law, conflict avoidance, police direction and official devices.
Record stopping purpose, traffic conflicts, safety conditions and any applicable legal, police or official-device direction.
Specify the other vehicle's following route and retain motion before, during and after the stop.
witness_review.reason: An intentional destination stop on a one-way roadway can affect traffic using the same route.
